summary: A lightweight, dynamically resizing bitset implementation in C++ that efficiently stores and manipulates individual bits using an underlying array of uint64_t blocks, providing runtime capacity adjustment unlike std::bitset.
key_features: Full value semantics with copy-and-swap idiom
achievements: Implemented dynamic memory management for bit storage with automatic resizing when exceeding capacity. Designed exception-safe resource handling using the copy-and-swap idiom for robust copy/move semantics. Optimized set operations (union, intersection, subset checks) via 64-bit block-level bitwise manipulation. Delivered a standalone, zero-dependency library with a complete test suite ensuring correctness and performance.
